transcription.from: src/equilibrium/activities.jl, ChemistryLab 0.22.2 (REJ_HKF and the defaults of HKFActivityModel)
transcription.note: Moved out of the code unchanged. The article was not re-read during the move: the locations are the ones the package has cited. The Debye-Hueckel A and B are also reproduced to 1e-3 by hkf_debye_huckel_params from the package's own water model, which test/activities.jl checks.

debye_huckel_A_25C.description: Debye-Hueckel A of water at 25 C and 1 bar, in (kg/mol)^(1/2), for decimal logarithms.

debye_huckel_B_25C.description: Debye-Hueckel B of water at 25 C and 1 bar, in 1/Angstrom (kg/mol)^(1/2).

notes: Species are keyed by their PHREEQC formula. The radii are used by HKFActivityModel as ion-size parameters of the extended Debye-Hueckel equation.
